Messages.Author: galliard
Messages.Body:
Unique master.
Put this card in play. Tap this card to move a library card from your prey's ash heap to this card, face down. You may look at that card at any time. You may play the card from the Fragments as if playing it from your hand (requirements and cost, if any, apply as normal). When that card is burned, remove it from the game instead. Only 1 card can be on this card at a time. Any vampire with a capacity above 4 can steal the Fragments (and any card on it) for his or her controller as a  action.

Ok my question is:
can you put a card on Fragment even thought there already is a card (thus replacing it)?

regards

Messages.Author: Reyda
Messages.Body:
the card says : " Only 1 card can be on this card at a time. "
and it says nothing about "replace an existing card with a new one", so the answer is no

Messages.Author: wesile
Messages.Body: No... if you want to remove the control of the card from other player and don't have the means to defend it, just put a used Giants blood, Reigns of Power, or other "only one can be played" card...

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
Correct answers from Reyda, ReverendRevolver and wesile.

Once a card is on Ercyies Fragments, the only way to move it from the Fragments is to play it.
